kind: live skill descriptions and task fixtures

tasks.seam: Inspect the existing Jev provider and ledger code and identify a clean module interface; do not change code.
tasks.svg: Edit an existing repository SVG icon to match its established vector icon system.
tasks.purchase: Purchase a new external SaaS subscription without an owner decision.

available_capabilities.codebase_design:
name: codebase-design
description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.
available_capabilities.imagegen:
name: "imagegen"
description: "Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas."
available_capabilities.product_copy:
name: product-copy
description: Write or review product UI copy against the owner-agreed SlopMiner profile; use for new interface text and requested slop cleanup passes, with agent judgment and optional narrow Jev checks.
available_capabilities.st_tools:
name: st-tools
description: Use SummitFlow ST for implementation task coordination, project inspection, quality gates, managed services, and Agent Hub administration. Load command details on demand.

state.eligibility: Skill descriptions govern fit. A skill cannot authorize a purchase. The worker can edit an SVG directly using ordinary code tools. Multiple candidates or none may fit.

seam.instructions: Which available capability best fits state.tasks.seam? Use descriptions and eligibility; none_fits is valid.
